hero.label: Made for Manufact
hero.headline: I want to help Manufact own the AI developer tools conversation.
hero.subheadline: Manufact is doing something genuinely rare: building real infrastructure for the MCP and AI agent ecosystem at the exact moment developers are trying to figure out what tools to trust. I want to be the person who makes sure the right builders find Manufact first. My background running cold outreach pipelines and working inside a B2B digital marketing consultancy means I know how to generate demand in technical markets without wasting budget.

whyCompany.title: MCP and AI agent tooling is the infrastructure layer everyone needs right now
whyCompany.body: The race to build reliable connectors for Claude, ChatGPT, and custom AI agents is happening in real time, and most developers are still stitching things together manually. Manufact sits at the exact intersection of open-source credibility and cloud infrastructure where trust gets built early. Winning mindshare in this window means owning the category before it consolidates.

whyCompany.title: Early-stage hiring means the first marketer shapes everything that follows
whyCompany.body: A Marketing and Events Lead hire at this stage is not a support role, it is a founding role for how the world understands what Manufact is. The positioning, the community presence, the events strategy, and the content voice all get decided now. That kind of ownership is exactly what I am looking for as my first full-time role out of school.

whyCompany.title: My BDR and digital marketing roots map directly onto what this role demands
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I built outbound sequences from scratch using HubSpot and LinkedIn to help land 15 to 20 paying clients, so I understand how to move technical buyers through a funnel before there is much brand awareness to lean on. At NextAfter I worked inside a B2B consultancy running digital campaigns and learning how data-driven marketing decisions get made at the strategic level. Both experiences prepared me to come in and execute immediately for a developer-focused audience.

quote: I have spent the last year learning how to get technical buyers to pay attention to something new. Manufact is building the kind of infrastructure that developers will rely on for the next decade, and I want to be the person who makes sure they find it.
